text.en:
The salary of the Speaker of the National Assembly is hereby increased to P85,000 per annum
and the salary of Deputy Prime Minister is hereby fixed at P80,000 per annum.

There is hereby appropriated out of any funds in the National Treasury not otherwise
appropriated, such sum as may be necessary to pay the salaries provided in Section 1 hereof.

This Decree shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 11th day of June, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and seventy
